title: squalify must profile every field with types, statistics and shapes in bounded memory
lead: Past a cap, the value is reported as exceeded until sq-11 adds sketches. Delimited text uses the accumulator first, and later formats reuse it.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** sketches (sq-11); top-k values and lexical min/max (sq-07); header-unit conventions (sq-14).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Goals: full-scan statistics with bounded memory, and values only on request.

Owner decisions (2026-10-13):
- Numeric **and temporal** min/max, mean, stddev and quantiles are included by default.
- Types use the strict rule plus votes, over the vocabulary `empty, bool, int, float, date, datetime, time, string`.
- Caps: 10,000 exact distinct values and 100,000 exact quantile values per field, and 64 shapes.

A global memory budget keeps wide files bounded: 2,000 columns × 100,000 doubles would otherwise need 1.6 GB.

sections.heading: Files
Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `Type_StrictJoin` (theory over every pair in the lattice).
2. `Type_DominantReported_WhenMixed`: 99 floats and 1 string give `string`, with dominant float at 0.99.
3. `NumericStats_WelfordAndNearestRank`: values computed by hand.
4. `Temporal_MinMaxIso_DefaultOn`.
5. `Shapes_MaskRulesAndCap`.
6. `Monotonic_SweepColumn_Increasing`: the `Frequency(MHz)` column of the DataBall sweep.
7. `Distinct_ExactUpToCap_ThenExceeds`, using a small injected cap.
8. `MemoryBudget_WideFile_ReducesPerFieldCaps_RecordedInLimits`: a generated file with 2,000 columns.
9. `NoLiteralStrings_WithoutIncludeValues`: string fields carry only counts, lengths and shapes.
10. The sq-04 goldens are re-recorded, and their diff is reviewed in the PR.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests.
2. Implement the accumulator, then the budget, then the delimited wiring.
3. Mutation checks: change the int ∨ float join to string, and test 1 must go red. Use ⌈p·n⌉ instead of ⌈p·n⌉−1, and test 3 must go red.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `dotnet build squalify.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet test squalify.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet format squalify.sln --verify-no-changes`
- If this slice changed architecture (the pipeline, an interface, a descriptor section or a determinism rule), `docs/how-it-works.md` and its diagrams are updated and `./scripts/render-docs.sh` has been re-run. The architect confirms there is no drift.
- `slicer check`

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/sq-05` on branch `sq-05`. No agent commits. After the gate returns `VERDICT: PASS`, the orchestrator commits `sq-05: field profiling` when the owner approves.
